native_context: Tenant invitation, recipient and membership-role binding
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Tenant invitation, recipient and membership-role binding — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Trace inviter capability, invited recipient, tenant, proposed role, token storage and acceptance. Read how expired/revoked invites and existing membership are handled.
controls.controlled_verification: Using two owned tenants and inboxes, issue a low-role invitation and inspect whether acceptance can substitute its tenant, recipient or role. Compare the persisted membership with the signed/stored grant. For stale invitations, evaluate the stated revocation/role-change policy rather than assuming an invitation expires on every admin change.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Forwardable invitations may be intentional for some products; a recipient binding claim needs the actual policy. An accepted HTTP response without membership creation is not a role escalation.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Resolve acceptance authority from the trusted invite record, enforce current inviter/grant rules as specified and consume atomically. Retest correct acceptance, mismatched identity/tenant and replay.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
